rule: 0DTE ATM call at every flat open; transform at +2% into weekly ATM (all proceeds); audited part-II trail exit with R = 0.25% of transform price
transform_day_trail_convention: trail arms next day (pre-trigger low unusable)
description: 0DTE proof -> weekly transform -> SABM trail (the H3 pipeline): every flat day buy a 0DTE ATM call at the open (premium = the whole risk); if the underlying rises 2% intraday (editable --transform-trigger-pct), all proceeds roll into a weekly ATM call at the trigger price, ridden under the audited SABM Part-II trail (R = 0.25% of the transform price, editable) with ATM re-strikes at each weekly expiry; the trail exit sells at model value. r is in proof-premium multiples (-1 = the premium, the whole risk).
note: BSM-priced both legs; transform fill pessimistically AT the trigger; a transform-day low below the trail counts pessimistically as a same-day trail exit (intraday order unknowable); daily proof spend = 1% of equity per attempt.
